name: Totem City
source:
The second game of the "Stop the Earth, I'm getting off!" series. The next story about the guy who travels between worlds in a very peculiar way. He changes bodies with his double when he has sex with special girls. The protagonist is now looking for his home world (our planet Earth) after visiting a high-tech world. This world is called the Crystal City. His journey begins in the Totem City - a place full of steampunk, demons, and unpleasant policies for ordinary citizens. But people who live here have features of totem animals: ears, tails and sharp teeth can look very cute. It will quite a task to get attention of such girls. But it must be done as there is only one way he can get home. And it is sex.

[From [url=https://7dots.itch.io/steigo2totemcity]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这是《让地球停下，我要下车！》系列的第二部游戏，继续讲述一个以奇特方式穿梭于不同世界的男人的故事。当他与某些特殊的女孩发生性关系时，就会与另一个世界中的自己交换身体。在造访了一个名为“水晶城”的高科技世界后，主人公如今正在寻找自己的故乡——我们所在的地球。这次旅程始于图腾城，一个充满蒸汽朋克气息、恶魔以及对普通市民不友好政策的地方。但这里的居民带有图腾动物的特征：耳朵、尾巴与尖牙，看上去也可以十分可爱。想要吸引这些女孩的注意，可不是件容易的事。但他必须做到，因为回家的方法只有一种——性。 

[摘自[url=https://7dots.itch.io/steigo2totemcity]itch.io[/url]]
